newsitem.title: USA: CME May lumber up $10/tbf limit on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: CME May lumber up $10/tbf limit on short-covering.

text.p: CME May lumber futures rose the $10.00 per tbf daily limit on short-covering and activation of chart-based buy orders, CME traders said.
Traders said traders were growing optimistic of higher cash lumber prices soon ahead of the spring construction season.

Random Lengths early Wednesday reported cash lumber business had increased lumber business as weather improved throughout much of the U.S. However, concerns about more Canadian lumber entering the U.S. and the recent quarter-percent rise in interest rates had weighed on cash prices.
At 1249 CST, lumber was up $10.00 to down $2.40 per tbf with May up the limit at $382.90.
